name: mio-run-one-packet-design
notes: DESIGN ONLY; every uses below is a proposed wrapper. Render after a complete plan. frozen_plan and claim_request are content-bound receipts from the future protocol, not a boolean authorization flag. No pipeline run command is claimed to work today.

open_packet.notes: PROPOSED gate. Independently revalidate all input identities and protected dates. Atomically claim in the shared exposure registry before descendants can read values. Plan-only checks never claim. Persist exposed state through child failure. No absent/changed/reset ledger accepted.

intake.notes: PROPOSED reader. The permit names source pins and exact allowed read bounds. Resolve only onboarded snapshots. Pair and time filters/projections apply before materialization. Pass forecasts and date-D context/quotes to decisions; bars advance as a prefix. Keep evaluation settlements separate. Any value read consumes the declared packet, including the tail.

study.notes: PROPOSED wrapper of WeeklyOptionPortfolioStudy. Sequential fixed methods, same input snapshot, sparse pair allowlist and decision calendar; independent equal-funded accounts. No starts/entries/deposits from prehistory and no orders/fills/deposits in the tail. Timeout skips and whole-method failures remain visible. Validate every ledger and recorded-decision replay before completion.

close_packet.notes: PROPOSED attested publication. Publish complete results and identity as JsonArtifact only when every required variant and settlement audit is complete. Driver/context failure leaves the already-claimed packet exposed; it never reopens. Do not auto-advance to another packet.
